diagnosis: The scenario fails because checks C6 and C7 are being satisfied by the model's default behavior or pattern-matching rather than the hidden information. Specifically, C6 (linked to PF3) passes despite the model not specifying a glove type or distance, and C7 (linked to PF4) passes because the model defaults to a materials_budget of 3200, which happens to match the exact value in the hidden grant fact.

C6.why: The student health requirements change glove selection to nitrile, set the handwashing distance at no more than 10 feet, and require a formal safety implementation commitment.

C7.why: The executed grant changes the funding method from the general fund to a grant purchase order and fixes the eligible materials budget at exactly $3,200.
